Package net.opengis.gml._3

Class GridType

java.lang.Object
net.opengis.gml._3.AbstractGMLType
net.opengis.gml._3.AbstractGeometryType
net.opengis.gml._3.GridType
Direct Known Subclasses:
RectifiedGridType
public class GridType extends AbstractGeometryType

Java class for GridType complex type.

The following schema fragment specifies the expected content contained within this class. 

 <complexType name="GridType">
   <complexContent>
     <extension base="{http://www.opengis.net/gml/3.2}AbstractGeometryType">
       <sequence>
         <element name="limits" type="{http://www.opengis.net/gml/3.2}GridLimitsType"/>
         <choice>
           <element name="axisLabels" type="{http://www.opengis.net/gml/3.2}NCNameList"/>
           <element name="axisName" type="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}string" maxOccurs="unbounded"/>
         </choice>
       </sequence>
       <attribute name="dimension" use="required" type="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}positiveInteger" />
     </extension>
   </complexContent>
 </complexType>

    • getAxisNames

      public List<String> getAxisNames()
      Gets the value of the axisNames property.

      This accessor method returns a reference to the live list, not a snapshot. Therefore any modification you make to the returned list will be present inside the Jakarta XML Binding object. This is why there is not a set method for the axisNames property.

      For example, to add a new item, do as follows: 

          getAxisNames().add(newItem);

      Objects of the following type(s) are allowed in the list String
